references.text: God's original instruction to Moses to make a covering of red ram skins and a covering of porpoise skins over the tabernacle. Exodus 36:19 describes the execution of this instruction.
The list of materials collected from the people, including red ram skins and porpoise skins, which were later used to make the covering described in 36:19.
Describes how the people brought red ram skins and porpoise skins as offerings, materials that were used for the covering in 36:19.
Summary of the finished parts of the tabernacle, including the covering of red ram skins and the covering of porpoise skins.
The responsibility of the Gershonites to carry the tabernacle coverings, including the covering of porpoise skins mentioned in Exodus 36:19.
